attchmntText: Divi's Laboratories Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Divi's Laboratories Limited filed newspaper clippings with the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited regarding the publication of unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were published on November 08, 2026, in the Financial Express English daily across all editions and in the Andhra Prabha Telugu daily for the Hyderabad edition. This filing is submitted for information and records in compliance with Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The document includes a Telugu translation of the English notice. No other corporate actions, resolutions, or financial figures are detailed in this specific submission.

attchmntText: Divi's Laboratories Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Divi's Laboratories Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during its Board meeting on November 07, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs. 3647 Crores, with a profit after tax of Rs. 1140 Crores. Earnings per share stood at Rs. 42.97. For the half year, standalone revenue was Rs. 6621 Crores, and profit after tax was Rs. 2031 Crores. Consolidated revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs. 3676 Crores. The statutory auditors issued an unmodified limited review report on the standalone financial statements. The meeting commenced at 10.30 Hrs and concluded at 11.40 Hrs.
